title: CVE-2026-107145 — The twofactor_gauthenticator plugin for Roundcube is vulnerable to brute-forcing of the second-factor code
summary:
The twofactor_gauthenticator plugin for Roundcube is vulnerable to brute-forcing of the second-factor code. Due to the lack of rate limiting, an attacker who obtains user's password can submit arbitrary 6-digit codes, resulting in second-factor bypass and unauthorized access to the system.




This issue was fixed in commit 4640889.

title: CVE-2026-107146 — The twofactor_gauthenticator plugin for Roundcube is vulnerable to session persistence after failed 2FA verification
summary:
The twofactor_gauthenticator plugin for Roundcube is vulnerable to session persistence after failed 2FA verification. Due to the lack of server-side session destruction, an attacker can ignore the logout redirect and keep the session alive. This may allow an attacker who obtains user's password to e.g. brute force the second-factor code.




This issue was fixed in commit 4640889.
title_vi: CVE-2026-107146 — Plugin twofactor_gauthenticator cho Roundcube dễ bị tấn công sau khi xác minh 2FA không thành công

title: CVE-2026-107147 — The twofactor_gauthenticator plugin for Roundcube is vulnerable to 2fa authentication bypass by spoofed client address headers
summary:
The twofactor_gauthenticator plugin for Roundcube is vulnerable to 2fa authentication bypass by spoofed client address headers. Due to the lack of validation of the Client-IP and X-Forwarded-For headers, an attacker who obtains user's password can spoof a whitelisted IP address, resulting in the second factor being bypassed.




This issue was fixed in commit 4640889.

Restoring the service requires power cycling the affected device, while other device functions remain operational.

title: CVE-2026-116870 — In affected versions of Octopus Server, OIDC token issuer validation was performed inconsistently
summary: In affected versions of Octopus Server, OIDC token issuer validation was performed inconsistently. This could result in a token issued from a suitably configured non legitimate issuer being accepted as a token belonging to a service account from a legitimate trusted issuer. Exploitation requires a service account with at least one OIDC identity configured. An attacker would also need to know or guess some details of that identity in order to be in a position to attempt exploitation.

title: CVE-2026-116871 — Semantic MediaWiki 3
summary: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in LegacyParser::getSubqueryDescription() that processes nested query tokens before depth limits apply. Unauthenticated attackers can submit deeply nested query elements to the action=ask API to consume substantial CPU and memory, tying up request workers.

title: CVE-2026-116872 — Semantic MediaWiki from 3
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in TermParser::normalize_compact_form() that allows unauthenticated attackers to cause quadratic CPU consumption. Attackers can submit long search terms with many distinct in:(...) or has:(...) expressions to Special:Search to exhaust PHP search workers when the extended search engine is enabled.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116872 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116873 — Semantic MediaWiki from 7
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 7.3.0 before 7.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the smwtask API module that allows unauthenticated attackers to run queued jobs and force store updates. Attackers can use the public anonymous CSRF token with run-joblist to execute arbitrary job types in unbounded counts, or invoke update on sysop-protected pages, leaking page titles and exhausting resources.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116873 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 7

title: CVE-2026-116874 — SemanticMediaWiki from 3
summary: SemanticMediaWiki from 3.1.0 before 7.3.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the unescaped default parameter in JsonResultPrinter. Attackers can lure victims to a crafted Special:Ask link with a zero-result query and request_type=special_page, executing JavaScript in the wiki origin to steal sessions or CSRF tokens.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116874 — SemanticMediaWiki từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116875 — SemanticMediaWiki from 3
summary: SemanticMediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in Special:Ask, which outputs separator parameters (sep, propsep, valuesep, delim, separator) without HTML escaping in list, category, DSV, and CSV result printers. Unauthenticated attackers can send victims crafted Special:Ask links using request_type=raw or request_type=special_page to execute JavaScript in the wiki's origin, stealing sessions or CSRF tokens.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116875 — SemanticMediaWiki từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116876 — Semantic MediaWiki from 2
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 2.5.0 before 7.3.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows ordinary editors to permanently protect pages by adding an Is edit protected annotation. When $smwgEditProtectionRight is enabled, EditProtectionUpdater applies indefinite edit and move restrictions without checking the author's rights, locking other editors and administrators out.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116876 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 2

title: CVE-2026-116877 — Semantic MediaWiki from 2
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 2.5.0 before 7.3.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows low-privilege editors to bypass smwgMaxNumRecurringEvents by supplying a large limit parameter. Attackers can save pages using #set_recurring_event without an end date to generate thousands or millions of date subobjects, exhausting CPU, memory, and database resources.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116877 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 2

title: CVE-2026-116878 — Semantic MediaWiki from 2
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 2.5.0 before 7.3.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows anonymous attackers to force quadratic computation by supplying a zero limit to Special:PropertyLabelSimilarity. Attackers can send repeated requests with limit=0 to bypass the SQL LIMIT and trigger pairwise similar_text() comparisons, exhausting PHP CPU, memory, and database connections.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116878 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 2

title: CVE-2026-116879 — Semantic MediaWiki from 7
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 7.3.0 before 7.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the smwtask update task that allows users with edit rights to force semantic updates on arbitrary pages. Attackers can supply a serialized subject parameter for a restricted page to trigger forced reparsing, semantic-store writes, and resource-intensive dependency work.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116879 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 7

title: CVE-2026-116880 — Semantic MediaWiki from 3
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in Special:SMWAdmin because it overwrites the wpEditToken with a freshly generated valid token. Attackers can lure an authenticated smw-admin user to a malicious page that triggers schema setup, entity-disposal, or job actions, causing semantic data loss and resource exhaustion.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116880 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116881 — Semantic MediaWiki from 3
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject markup by storing malicious semantic property values rendered unescaped in autocomplete suggestions. When another user opens the property-value autocomplete with an empty query, jquery.autocomplete.js concatenates the raw PValueLookup API value into HTML via container.html(), altering the dropdown and potentially executing script.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116881 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116882 — Semantic MediaWiki from 4
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 4.2.0 before 7.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated profile or schema editors to inject HTML through FacetedSearch exploration-link labels. Attackers can store markup in the label, which ExploreListBuilder::buildHTML() passes unescaped to Html::rawElement(), altering the Special:FacetedSearch page and potentially running scripts in viewers' browsers.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116882 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 4

title: CVE-2026-116883 — Semantic MediaWiki from 3
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 3.1.0 before 7.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated schema editors to inject HTML through schema descriptions. title_vi: CVE-2026-116883 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116884 — SemanticMediaWiki from 5

Editors can plant a .smw-highlighter span with a malicious data-content, data-title, data-top, data-bottom, or data-theme attribute to execute JavaScript when viewers, including administrators, hover it.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116884 — SemanticMediaWiki từ 5

title: CVE-2026-116885 — Semantic MediaWiki from 3
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 3.1.0 before 7.3.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Special:SMWAdmin ID lookup that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject markup through the unescaped id parameter. Attackers can lure an smw-admin administrator into opening a crafted lookup link, bypassing the auto-satisfied edit-token check, to execute script and perform privileged actions in the administrator's session.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116885 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116886 — Semantic MediaWiki from 2
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 2.5.0 before 7.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with page-edit rights to inject scripts via External identifier property values. title_vi: CVE-2026-116886 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 2

title: CVE-2026-116887 — Semantic MediaWiki from 3
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with page-edit rights to inject HTML through Keyword-typed property values rendered unescaped on Special:Browse. Attackers can annotate a Keyword property with an event-handler payload that executes JavaScript in viewers' sessions, including administrators, to read tokens and perform actions.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116887 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116888 — SemanticMediaWiki from 3
summary: SemanticMediaWiki from 3.2.0 before 7.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with the smw-schemaedit right to inject markup through an unescaped property group schema canonical_name. title_vi: CVE-2026-116888 — SemanticMediaWiki từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116889 — SemanticMediaWiki from 2
summary: SemanticMediaWiki from 2.5.0 before 7.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with page-edit rights to inject script through Code-typed property values. title_vi: CVE-2026-116889 — SemanticMediaWiki từ 2

title: CVE-2026-116890 — Semantic MediaWiki from 3
summary: Semantic MediaWiki from 3.0.0 before 7.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the api.php smwtask module that allows unauthenticated attackers to run admin-only maintenance tasks. Attackers can use the public anonymous CSRF token to read internal store statistics, enqueue jobs like smw.entityIdDisposer, and execute queued jobs, degrading performance and altering semantic data.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116890 — Semantic MediaWiki từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116891 — SemanticMediaWiki from 4
summary: SemanticMediaWiki from 4.2.0 before 7.2.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject HTML via unescaped cstate parameters in Special:FacetedSearch. Attackers can craft URLs with q, a matching crc32 csum or filtered=1, and cstate values that break out of hidden input attributes to execute script in victims' browsers.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116891 — SemanticMediaWiki từ 4

title: CVE-2026-116892 — SemanticMediaWiki from 3
summary: SemanticMediaWiki from 3.1.0 before 7.3.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject markup through the search parameter of the extended Special:Search profile. title_vi: CVE-2026-116892 — SemanticMediaWiki từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116893 — REDAXO core before 5
summary: REDAXO core before 5.21.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the rex_api_package API function that lets non-admin backend users manage packages with only a valid CSRF token. Attackers holding a token, such as demoted admins with active sessions, can uninstall system addons like structure (dropping their database tables), deactivate, install, or activate packages, and delete non-system packages.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116893 — Lõi REDAXO trước 5

title: CVE-2026-116894 — REDAXO before 5
summary: REDAXO before 5.21.5 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to retain account access by keeping the current session and stay-logged-in key valid after a password change. Attackers who obtained a user's session id or stay-logged-in cookie can keep backend access after the password change, via the cookie for up to three months.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116894 — REDAXO trước 5

title: CVE-2026-116895 — REDAXO before 5
summary: REDAXO before 5.21.5 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability because the backend processes the safemode GET parameter in index.php without validating a CSRF token. Attackers can lure a logged-in administrator into opening a crafted link to disable global safe mode, writing safe_mode: false to config.yml, or enable session safe mode, disabling backend addons.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116895 — REDAXO trước 5

title: CVE-2026-116896 — REDAXO before 5
summary: REDAXO before 5.21.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the backup addon export that accepts any database table, allowing non-admin users with the backup[export] permission to export rex_user, rex_user_session, and other applications' tables. Attackers can obtain plaintext session ids and stay-logged-in keys to take over admin accounts, or password hashes for offline cracking.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116896 — REDAXO trước 5

title: CVE-2026-116897 — REDAXO core before 5
summary: REDAXO core before 5.21.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the structure/version and structure/history frontend preview modes, which do not check category or clang permissions for the previewed article. Any backend user, or one holding history[article_rollback], can set rex_version or rex_history_date with arbitrary article_id values to read unpublished working versions and historic or deleted content.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116897 — Lõi REDAXO trước 5

title: CVE-2026-116898 — REDAXO before 5
summary: REDAXO before 5.21.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the media pool bulk move that checks only target category permission, ignoring the source category. title_vi: CVE-2026-116898 — REDAXO trước 5

title: CVE-2026-116899 — REDAXO before 5
summary: REDAXO before 5.21.4 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated editors to modify slices in unauthorized categories by pairing a permitted article with a foreign slice id. title_vi: CVE-2026-116899 — REDAXO trước 5

title: CVE-2026-117533 — REDAXO from 5
summary: REDAXO from 5.18.0 before 5.21.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because rex_media_service moves uploaded SVG files into the public media folder before sanitizing them. title: CVE-2026-117534 — REDAXO before 5
summary: REDAXO before 5.21.3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the structure/history plugin that allows attackers to delete history or roll back content via unvalidated GET requests. title: CVE-2026-117535 — REDAXO before 5
summary: REDAXO before 5.21.3 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the backend media pool detail page, where the opener_link parameter is rendered without HTML escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can lure logged-in backend users with media permissions into clicking a crafted link. The injected script can then read the CSRF token and perform actions with the victim's permissions, including code execution via template or module edits when the victim is an administrator.

title: CVE-2026-117536 — REDAXO before 5
summary: REDAXO before 5.21.3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the backend user administration page (users/users) because the CSRF token check only runs when the save parameter is set, while the update path triggered by FUNC_UPDATE does not require it. Attackers can lure a logged-in backend user with the users[] permission to a crafted GET link to grant administrator rights, deactivate accounts, or lock out the sole administrator.

title: CVE-2026-117537 — REDAXO before 5
summary: REDAXO before 5.21.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to inject scripts via the type parameter of the metainfo_default_fields_create API. Attackers can craft a link with a valid CSRF token and HTML payload that rex_view::message() renders unescaped, executing scripts in a victim's backend session.

title: CVE-2026-117538 — REDAXO before 5
summary: REDAXO before 5.21.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the backend packages API, where the function parameter is concatenated into an error message rendered without HTML escaping. Attackers can lure an authenticated backend user to a crafted link containing a valid CSRF token, executing JavaScript that performs same-origin actions or reads DOM data.

summary: darylldoyle svg-sanitizer before 1.0.0 contains CSS injection and remote reference bypass vulnerabilities that allow attackers to embed external resources by uploading crafted SVG files. title: CVE-2026-117540 — svg-sanitizer from 0

title: CVE-2026-117541 — svg-sanitizer from 0

title: CVE-2026-115216 — In Eclipse ioFog Operator versions 3
summary: In Eclipse ioFog Operator versions 3.8.0 before 3.9.2, TLS certificate verification is disabled when the operator contacts the Controller API and when it logs in to an external OIDC issuer. An on-path attacker can present any certificate, capture the OAuth client secret (external mode) or the Controller bootstrap admin password (embedded mode with Controller HTTPS enabled), and supply the access token the operator stores for later Controller API calls. v3.8 removed Keycloak. The exposed credential is not a Keycloak realm-admin secret.

title: CVE-2026-117499 — @fastify/session is a session plugin for Fastify
summary: @fastify/session is a session plugin for Fastify. In all releases before 11.1.6, with the default rolling session behavior, a request that restored a session before a logout could save its own copy after another request had completed the session destroy call, recreating the destroyed session identifier with its authenticated data. An attacker who already holds a victim's valid signed session cookie and keeps a request in flight across the logout can replay that cookie to restore the session after it was meant to be revoked, without any cookie theft or signature forgery. title: CVE-2026-13162 — An OS command vulnerability exists in CoreTec product that allows authenticated users with certain roles to execute arbitrary system commands with ful
summary: An OS command vulnerability exists in CoreTec product that allows authenticated users with certain roles to execute arbitrary system commands with full control over the device. The vulnerability exists in the configuration daemon's time synchronization handler, which is responsible for setting the system time-zone. When processing time-zone configuration updates, the daemon constructs a shell command by concatenating user-supplied input without any sanitization or validation.

title: CVE-2026-41021 — Eaton easyE4 uses an insufficiently strong password policy
summary: Eaton easyE4 uses an insufficiently strong password policy. An attacker who obtains a password hash, including through CVE-2026-41020, could perform an offline password-guessing attack and potentially recover user credentials.

title: CVE-2026-41022 — Eaton easySoft improperly validates TLS certificates presented by easyE4 devices
summary: Eaton easySoft improperly validates TLS certificates presented by easyE4 devices. A network-adjacent attacker could exploit this weakness to perform a man-in-the-middle attack and potentially intercept or modify communications between easySoft and easyE4.

title: CVE-2026-107590 — An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Qt QTextCodec iconv-based encoding of the Qt 5 Compatibility APIs module (Qt Core in Qt 5 and earlier) imp
summary: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Qt QTextCodec iconv-based encoding of the Qt 5 Compatibility APIs module (Qt Core in Qt 5 and earlier) impacts Qt. Under certain conditions, encoding text with QTextCodec may write outside an internal buffer. This can cause the application to crash and may affect data integrity.

title: CVE-2026-114409 — Docker Desktop before version 4
summary: Docker Desktop before version 4.97.0 could write third-party API keys and OAuth access tokens in cleartext to local application logs and diagnostics bundles due to insufficient IPC payload redaction. An attacker with read access to these files could obtain the credentials. These OAuth tokens are not Docker account tokens. Docker Desktop 4.94.0 and 4.95.0 addressed the known logging paths, but logs containing credentials can remain after upgrading. Docker Desktop 4.97.0 fixes the issue and includes cleanup of existing host logs and crash dumps.

title: CVE-2026-116627 — Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in the notifications feature in Devolutions PowerShell Universal
summary: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in the notifications feature in Devolutions PowerShell Universal 2026.3.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user with notification creation permission to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of another user via a crafted notification target URL.

title: CVE-2026-117503 — A vulnerability was determined in a2aproject a2a-go up to 2
summary: A vulnerability was determined in a2aproject a2a-go up to 2.4.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file a2asrv/rest.go of the component REST SSE handler. This manipulation causes resource consumption. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 2.5.0 is recommended to address this issue. Patch name: ff6035bd21e44bb3ee1bfa547885b8c08327fa01. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

title: CVE-2026-117504 — A vulnerability was identified in a2aproject a2a-go up to 2
summary: A vulnerability was identified in a2aproject a2a-go up to 2.4.0. The affected element is the function Cancel of the file internal/taskexec/distributed_manager.go of the component Distributed Manager. Such manipulation leads to denial of service. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 2.5.0 is sufficient to fix this issue. The name of the patch is 14e41a978b31e134ffa1170d8657f9dd98529aa3. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

title: CVE-2026-117553 — Umbraco CMS before 17
summary: Umbraco CMS before 17.7.2 and 18.2.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to register attacker-controlled OAuth redirect URIs by poisoning the Host header. Attackers send signed-in users authorization links using response_mode=form_post to capture codes, then redeem them via HTTP Basic client credentials to hijack back-office sessions and execute code through Razor templates.

title: CVE-2026-117554 — Admidio before 5
summary: Admidio before 5.0.17 contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows authenticated members to register event guests by submitting the additional_guests field when guests are disallowed. Attackers can set additional_guests to the remaining seat count in modules/events/events_function.php to exhaust event capacity and block other members from registering.

title: CVE-2026-117555 — CImg through 4
summary: CImg through 4.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the _load_bmp() function of CImg.h caused by an integer overflow in the row byte count. Attackers can supply a crafted BMP file with a large header width that wraps dx_bytes, causing crashes or heap memory disclosure into the decoded image.

title: CVE-2026-117556 — zchunk before 1
summary: zchunk before 1.5.5 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in read_preface() in src/lib/header.c that passes the total header length instead of remaining bytes to compint parsing functions. Attackers can supply a crafted .zck file whose header ends inside a compressed integer, causing reads past the heap header buffer and crashing the application.

title: CVE-2026-117557 — SDL_image through 3
summary: SDL_image through 3.4.8 and through 2.8.12 contains a stack out-of-bounds read vulnerability in IMG_LoadLBM_IO() in src/IMG_lbm.c that skips bitplane count validation when HAM mode is set. Attackers can supply a crafted ILBM file with more than 8 HAM bitplanes to read past the colormap stack array, causing crashes or disclosing stack memory.

title: CVE-2026-117558 — The ai-sdlc plugin MCP server through 0
summary: The ai-sdlc plugin MCP server through 0.31.2 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute commands by supplying shell metacharacters in the repo argument. The unvalidated repo value is interpolated into gh issue view or gh pr view commands run via execSync(), letting prompt-injected agents execute commands as the MCP server user.

title: CVE-2026-117559 — DroidMind through 0
summary: DroidMind through 0.4.0 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows MCP clients to bypass the shell command allowlist by using $(...) or backtick substitution. Attackers, including prompt-injected agents, can inject commands through parameters interpolated into Device.run_shell() or unvalidated Device.list_directory() to run blocked commands such as reboot on connected Android devices.

title: CVE-2026-117560 — ATXP Gemini CLI extension through 1
summary: ATXP Gemini CLI extension through 1.0.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in runAtxp() that allows attackers to execute shell commands through unsanitized MCP tool parameters. Attackers can plant instructions in email or SMS content to inject $() or backtick substitutions into parameters like message_id, subject, or query, running commands as the user.

title: CVE-2026-117561 — Codefriar sf-mcp through 1
summary: Codefriar sf-mcp through 1.3.2 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute shell commands by supplying crafted Salesforce CLI tool flag values. Because escapeValue() in src/utils.ts fails to neutralize backticks, $() substitution, and other shell metacharacters, these values reach execSync in executeSfCommand and run as the MCP server user.

title: CVE-2026-117562 — rssant 1
summary: rssant 1.9.0 through 1.9.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read stories from unpublished feeds through the anonymous publish.story_get endpoint. Because UnionStory.get_by_feed_offset ignores the only_publish flag, attackers can enumerate feed IDs and offsets to retrieve private feed stories.

title: CVE-2026-117563 — MrDoc through 1
summary: MrDoc through 1.1.1 contains a broken access control vulnerability in the manage_doc_share type 3 branch that allows authenticated users to modify other users' document share settings because updates lack an ownership check. Attackers can compute predictable share tokens from the MD5 of document ID and username to re-enable disabled shares or remove access codes, exposing private documents.

title: CVE-2026-117564 — nest-admin before 1
summary: nest-admin before 1.0.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens by using a hardcoded JWT_SECRET committed in .env.production. Attackers can sign tokens with the known secret that JwtStrategy and RbacGuard trust, impersonating any user ID or claiming the admin role for full administrative access.

title: CVE-2026-117565 — Artalk before 2
summary: Artalk before 2.10.1 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to make the server fetch arbitrary URLs by submitting anonymous comments to /api/v2/comments. Attackers can set a page_key to an internal URL, which GetTitleByURL fetches after only scheme validation, then read the page title through the public comment list.

title: CVE-2026-117566 — EasyImages2
summary: EasyImages2.0 through 2.8.6 contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in app/down.php, app/thumb.php and app/info.php that allows reading files outside the upload directory. Attackers can supply ../ sequences in the dw, history or img parameters to read files with allowed upload extensions from the server.

title: CVE-2026-117567 — esp-mcp through commit 28afddf contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to run arbitrary commands by supplying shell metac
summary: esp-mcp through commit 28afddf contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to run arbitrary commands by supplying shell metacharacters in MCP tool parameters. Attackers influencing agent tool calls through prompt injection can inject metacharacters into target, port, project_path, or project_name values passed to asyncio.create_subprocess_shell, executing commands as the MCP server user.

title: CVE-2026-117568 — mcp-ffmpeg through 1
summary: mcp-ffmpeg through 1.0.5 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to run shell commands by supplying crafted videoPath or outputDir values to the resize-video, extract-audio and get-video-info tools. Attackers can embed $(), backticks or a closing double quote in an existing file or directory name to break out of the child_process.exec command string and execute commands as the MCP server user.

title: CVE-2026-117569 — Kali-GPT through commit a608c74 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in execute_tool() in kali_gpt/tools/mcp_server
summary: Kali-GPT through commit a608c74 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in execute_tool() in kali_gpt/tools/mcp_server.py that allows MCP clients to run commands via unsanitized scanner parameters. Attackers or prompt-injected agents can embed shell metacharacters in parameters like target, ports, domain, wordlist, or url, executed via subprocess.run with shell=True as the MCP server user.

title: CVE-2026-117570 — Vorota-ai nmap-mcp through commit 3636afa contains an improper allowlist validation vulnerability in the scan_vulnerabilities tool that lets callers r
summary: Vorota-ai nmap-mcp through commit 3636afa contains an improper allowlist validation vulnerability in the scan_vulnerabilities tool that lets callers run blocked NSE script categories. MCP clients or prompt-injected agents can pass categories like exploit, dos, brute, or intrusive to nmap --script, running intrusive, brute-force, exploit, or denial-of-service scripts against scan targets.

title: CVE-2026-117573 — hagent through commit 761eec6 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows MCP clients to execute shell commands by injecting metacharac
summary: hagent through commit 761eec6 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows MCP clients to execute shell commands by injecting metacharacters into the args parameter of the hagent_arduino and hagent_esp32 tools. Attackers or prompt-injected agents can supply crafted args interpolated into arduino-cli and idf.py commands run with subprocess.run(shell=True) to execute commands as the MCP server user.

title: CVE-2026-117601 — Electrum before 4
summary: Electrum before 4.8.3 fails to verify signatures of wallet-owned inputs in unconfirmed mempool transactions, allowing malicious servers to replace a just-broadcast transaction with a conflicting one. Attackers can swallow the user's transaction and display an invalid zero-fee copy paying an attacker address, tricking users into RBF fee-bumping and signing it.

title: CVE-2026-117602 — Electrum 4
summary: Electrum 4.6.0 before 4.7.2 contains an authorization bypass in the external plugin loader, which executes a plugin's __init__.py module when the plugin is marked enabled in the config file, without verifying its plugin-password signature. A rogue local process with write access to the Electrum data directory can place plugin code in the plugins/ folder and mark it enabled, causing arbitrary code execution inside the Electrum process.

title: CVE-2026-117603 — Electrum before 4
summary: Electrum before 4.7.2 contains a spending limit bypass vulnerability in the Nostr Wallet Connect plugin that allows malicious NWC clients to exceed daily_limit_sat by exploiting non-atomic budget checks and millisatoshi truncation. Attackers can send concurrent pay_invoice requests that pass budget_allows_spend() before add_to_budget() runs, or repeatedly pay msat amounts that are floored to whole satoshis, to drain funds beyond the limit.

title: CVE-2026-117468 — Psono Server versions 5
summary: Psono Server versions 5.3.5 through 7.2.3 used a permission class that did not enforce token write scope when claiming a device code. An authenticated remote attacker holding a restricted API key-derived session could claim an attacker-controlled device code and obtain a full read-write session valid for up to 365 days, bypassing the original token's scope and lifetime restrictions. This did not bypass two-factor authentication or directly disclose plaintext secrets.
title_vi: CVE-2026-117468 — Máy chủ Psono phiên bản 5

title: CVE-2026-117469 — Psono Server (CE & EE) versions 1
summary: Psono Server (CE & EE) versions 1.0.0 through 7.2.3 did not enforce the direction of file-transfer credentials on file-repository operations. An authenticated remote attacker with read-only access to a file could present a download transfer to the upload endpoint, obtain a signed upload URL for an attacker-selected object key, and append a chunk to the owner's file. Exploitation could upload or overwrite repository objects and consume storage, subject to transfer size, chunk-count, and lifetime limits.
title_vi: CVE-2026-117469 — Máy chủ Psono (CE & EE) phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-117470 — Psono Server CE & EE versions 3
summary: Psono Server CE & EE versions 3.1.0 through 7.2.3 did not consume a stored WebAuthn challenge after assertion verification. An unauthenticated remote attacker who possessed the user's password and one captured valid WebAuthn assertion could replay that assertion with separate login tokens while the stored challenge remained unchanged, bypassing the WebAuthn second factor. The attack required capture of a valid assertion and did not itself disclose plaintext secrets.
title_vi: CVE-2026-117470 — Psono Server CE & EE phiên bản 3

title: CVE-2026-117471 — Psono Server CE && EE versions 0
summary: Psono Server CE && EE versions 0.1.0 through 7.2.3 accepted a user-controlled host when configuring a personal Duo device and passed it to the Duo client without an allowlist or explicit timeout. An authenticated remote attacker could cause the server to connect to selected hosts over HTTPS on port 443 and distinguish failure modes, providing an internal DNS and service-reachability oracle. Connections still required TLS certificate validation, and the flaw did not provide arbitrary protocol or port access. Unresponsive targets could also occupy a server worker until the operating-system timeo
title_vi: CVE-2026-117471 — Psono Server CE && EE phiên bản 0

title: CVE-2026-117472 — Psono Server CE && EE versions 4
summary: Psono Server CE && EE versions 4.0.33 through 7.2.3 compared the request path for the bulk-secret-read endpoint with a hard-coded unprefixed path. In deployments configured with URL_PREFIX, the comparison failed and the POST request was authorized using write scope instead of read scope. An authenticated remote attacker with an unusual read-disabled, write-enabled API key could therefore retrieve encrypted secret data and nonces through the prefixed bulk-secret-read endpoint despite lacking read permission. The default configuration without URL_PREFIX was not affected.
title_vi: CVE-2026-117472 — Psono Server CE && EE phiên bản 4

summary: DOMPurify before 3.4.17 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to keep event handlers armed when an IN_PLACE hook removes a parent or sibling node. Attacker markup in detached subtrees is never walked or neutralized, so handlers like img onerror fire after sanitize() returns, causing DOM XSS.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116803 — DOMPurify trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116804 — DOMPurify from 3
summary: DOMPurify from 3.4.4 before 3.4.17 contains a SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES bypass that lets attackers preserve template expressions in attached shadow roots when using RETURN_DOM, RETURN_DOM_FRAGMENT, or IN_PLACE modes. Attackers can split expressions across text nodes separated by disallowed elements, which merge after removal and are evaluated by downstream template engines for cross-site scripting.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116804 — DOMPurify từ 3

title: CVE-2026-116805 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows read-level project members to obtain argon2id hashes of ingestion credentials through the client.list tRPC query. Attackers can request client.list with a project ID and receive full Client rows including the secret column, enabling offline verification of leaked secrets without audit trails.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116805 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116806 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the onboarding.project tRPC mutation that allows non-admin organization members to create projects and mint write-type ingestion credentials, bypassing the admin-only policy. Attackers can repeatedly call the endpoint with a member session to obtain plaintext secrets, inject fake analytics events, poison business metrics, and consume the organization's usage budget.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116806 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116807 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass tenant scoping by injecting unescaped profile filter names into a JOIN subquery. Attackers can supply a crafted filter name with a trailing comment to bypass the project_id WHERE clause and read events from all projects.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116807 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116808 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read cross-tenant data by supplying a crafted property parameter to profile.values. Attackers can inject a SELECT expression with their own FROM/WHERE clauses and comment out the project_id scope to exfiltrate other projects' profiles, events, and sessions.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116808 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116809 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the event.bots tRPC procedure that allows unauthenticated attackers to read bot events by only checking shareOverview row existence. Attackers can send anonymous requests with a projectId to retrieve bot-event names, types, and paths for private or password-protected projects, revealing internal routes.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116809 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116810 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read any project's annotations by calling the public reference.getChartReferences tRPC procedure. Attackers can send requests with guessable slug-based project IDs to dump cross-tenant annotation titles, descriptions, and dates such as release notes and deploy markers.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116810 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116811 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability in the js-runtime validator that allows a project member to bypass the AST allowlist by aliasing the Function constructor. Attackers with write access can read payload.constructor.constructor into a local and call it to run arbitrary code in the worker process.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116811 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116812 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a sql injection vulnerability in profileColumnAccess in cohort.service.ts that allows project-read members to inject SQL by supplying unescaped profile filter column names. Attackers can submit a cohort.preview filter whose name contains a subquery spliced into argMax, cityHash64, or comparison clauses to read other tenants' ClickHouse data.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116812 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116813 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability in ConversionService.getConversion that allows project-read members and share-link holders to inject ClickHouse SQL through unescaped event names and dates. Attackers can break out of string literals in series names or startDate/endDate values with OR 1=1 to neutralize project_id scoping and read other tenants' analytics data.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116813 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116814 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an information exposure vulnerability that writes database connection URLs and email template data to standard output logs. Users with log access can obtain database credentials from migration startup logs and password-reset tokens logged when SMTP_HOST and RESEND_API_KEY are unset.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116814 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116815 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an improper escaping vulnerability in sankey.service.ts that allows authenticated project members to break ClickHouse string literals by supplying backslashes in event names. Attackers with read access can submit crafted events[].name values to the chart.sankey procedure, causing ClickHouse parse errors that disable the project's Sankey chart endpoint.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116815 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116817 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access the Bull Board dashboard served on the worker HTTP port. Attackers can query /api/queues and call mutating Bull Board APIs to add, retry, or clean jobs and read queue data, metrics, and datastore health.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116817 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116818 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an unauthenticated ClickHouse sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject SQL through the projectId parameter of the /live/visitors/:projectId WebSocket, which lacks session and project-access checks. Attackers can use UNION or boolean count oracles to read other tenants' events and profiles, and project members can similarly inject via the cohort.preview timeframe values.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116818 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116819 — OpenPanel before 3
summary: OpenPanel before 3.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows read-level project members to obtain plaintext integration secrets because the notification.rules query skips redactIntegration. Attackers can call the notification.rules tRPC query to retrieve Slack bot tokens, webhook URLs, and authorization headers for use against external systems.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116819 — OpenPanel trước 3

title: CVE-2026-116820 — YesWiki from 4
summary: YesWiki from 4.6.0 before 4.7.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to view assembled SQL queries by adding the showreq parameter. Attackers can append showreq to public Bazar listing API requests to obtain table names, JSON storage paths, ACL filter logic, and collation, aiding targeted SQL injection.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116820 — YesWiki từ 4

title: CVE-2026-116821 — YesWiki before 4
summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a read-ACL bypass in AclService::updateRequestWithACL, which interpolates usernames into SQL LIKE patterns without escaping the _ and % wildcards. Self-registered attackers can use usernames such as ___ or %%% that over-match ACL tokens, reading pages and Bazar entries restricted to other users or groups via the public Bazar listing API.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116821 — YesWiki trước 4

title: CVE-2026-116822 — YesWiki before 4
summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in BazarListeAction that allows unauthenticated attackers to select arbitrary templates within the @bazar Twig namespace via the template GET parameter. Attackers can append crafted template values to pages containing the bazarliste action to force unintended layouts, causing page defacement for visitors following the crafted link.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116822 — YesWiki trước 4

title: CVE-2026-116823 — YesWiki before 4
summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject JavaScript by supplying query parameters matching missing Bazar field names. Attackers can craft links where BazarField::getValue() falls back to unsanitized $_REQUEST values rendered via Twig |raw templates, performing same-origin authenticated actions in victims' sessions.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116823 — YesWiki trước 4

title: CVE-2026-116824 — YesWiki before 4
summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in handlers/page/referrers_sites.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts via crafted Referer headers. Attackers can send a Referer hostname containing HTML metacharacters that renders unescaped, executing JavaScript for any referrer-sites page visitor to perform same-origin authenticated actions.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116824 — YesWiki trước 4

title: CVE-2026-116825 — YesWiki from 4
summary: YesWiki from 4.6.2 before 4.7.0 lacks replay protection in HttpSignatureService::verifySignature(), which never validates the Date header or tracks seen signatures. Attackers who capture a signed request to the /api/forms/{formId}/actor/inbox endpoint can replay it later to re-execute Delete, Update, Follow, or Undo actions.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116825 — YesWiki từ 4

title: CVE-2026-116826 — YesWiki before 4
summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in DuplicationManager::downloadFile() that allows authenticated administrators to make arbitrary outbound requests via the files array. Attackers can POST file:// or internal URLs to /api/pages/{tag}/duplicate, storing local files, cloud metadata, or database credentials in the publicly accessible files/ directory.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116826 — YesWiki trước 4

title: CVE-2026-116827 — YesWiki before 4
summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the Bazar CSV import copyUrlToLocalFile() function that allows authenticated administrators to make arbitrary outbound requests by supplying crafted URLs in CSV file or image fields. Attackers can bypass the extension check with a query-string suffix or redirects to fetch cloud metadata credentials, internal services, or local files via file://, with responses stored in the web-accessible files/ directory.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116827 — YesWiki trước 4

title: CVE-2026-116828 — YesWiki before 4
summary: YesWiki before 4.7.0 contains a sql injection vulnerability in despam.php where the from parameter is escaped but placed in an unquoted INTERVAL position. Authenticated administrators can inject SQL via the from POST parameter to perform blind reads of the database including user password hashes.
title_vi: CVE-2026-116828 — YesWiki trước 4

title: CVE-2026-116724 — FLTK through 1

title: CVE-2026-116725 — gbsplay through 0

title: CVE-2026-116726 — Gbsplay through 0
summary: Gbsplay through 0.0.103 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gbr_open() in gbs.c that fails to verify file length before scanning the GBR ROM title field. Attackers can supply a crafted GBR file of 0x21 to 0x162 bytes to read past the heap buffer, crashing gbsplay or leaking memory.

title: CVE-2026-116727 — gbsplay through 0
summary: gbsplay through 0.0.103 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in vgm_open() in gbs.c that walks the VGM command stream without bounds checks. Attackers can supply a crafted VGM file with wait opcodes and no 0x66 terminator to read past the heap buffer and crash the player.

summary: libfvde through 20260923 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libfvde_encrypted_metadata_read_type_0x0024() because xml_plist_data_size is not checked against the source metadata block. title: CVE-2026-116729 — libfvde through 20260923 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libfvde_encrypted_metadata_read_type_0x001a() caused by an unbounded strl
summary: libfvde through 20260923 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libfvde_encrypted_metadata_read_type_0x001a() caused by an unbounded strlen on embedded XML plist data. summary: Furnace through 0.6.8.3 contains an out-of-bounds heap read vulnerability in DivEngine::loadFTM() in src/engine/fileOps/ftm.cpp, triggered by an unbounded DPCM note count during FamiTracker module import. Attackers can craft a .ftm, .dnm or 0CC/E-FamiTracker module with a 2A03 instrument note count above 120 to read past the noteMap array and crash Furnace when opened.

title: CVE-2026-116731 — Furnace through 0
summary: Furnace through 0.6.8.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in DivEngine::loadFTM() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via an unchecked subsong index in the GROOVES block. title: CVE-2026-116733 — flatcc through 0

title: CVE-2026-116734 — flatcc through 0
summary: flatcc through 0.6.4 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the check_header function of the FlatBuffers verifier because its overflow guard is dead code. summary: libpff through 20260926 contains an off-by-one bounds check in libpff_table_read_6c_record_entries that allows attackers to trigger a heap out-of-bounds read via crafted 6c table record entries. summary: MacCMS v10 through 2026.1000.4056 contains a race condition vulnerability in Card::useData() that allows authenticated members to redeem one recharge card multiple times via the user/buy endpoint. Attackers can send many concurrent flag=card requests that pass the non-locking card read before it is marked used, inflating user_points to buy VIP upgrades and paid content.

title: CVE-2026-116216 — MacCMS v10 through 2026
summary: MacCMS v10 through 2026.1000.4056 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in index/Comment::saveData() that allows unauthenticated attackers to set arbitrary mac_comment columns including user_id. Attackers can submit anonymous comments with a crafted user_id parameter to attribute them to any registered member, displaying that member's avatar and impersonating them.

title: CVE-2026-116217 — RosarioSIS before 12
summary: RosarioSIS before 12.9.2 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in modules/Food_Service/MenuReports.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject attributes via unescaped menu_id and modname parameters. Attackers can lure a logged-in administrator to a crafted Modules.php link whose double-quoted menu_id injects an onmouseover handler, stealing session and CSRF tokens to act as the administrator.

title: CVE-2026-116218 — Dolibarr ERP CRM 19
summary: Dolibarr ERP CRM 19.0.0 before 23.0.4 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated API users to inject SQL via the type field of the third-party bankaccounts REST endpoint. Attackers with only societe/creer permission can break out of the unescaped type value in CompanyBankAccount::create() to read password hashes and API keys via time-based blind subqueries.

title: CVE-2026-116219 — Dolibarr ERP CRM before 24
summary: Dolibarr ERP CRM before 24.0.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in htdocs/admin/tools/export.php that lets authenticated administrators bypass the restrict_os_commands allowlist. Attackers can submit a mysqldump value chaining commands with & characters around an allowlisted basename to execute operating system commands as the web server user.

title: CVE-2026-116274 — A vulnerability has been found in JIZHICMS up to 2
summary: A vulnerability has been found in JIZHICMS up to 2.5.6. This affects the function Pay of the file app/home/c/OrderController.php of the component Front-end Order Handler. Such manipulation of the argument orderno leads to improper authorization. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: CVE-2026-116275 — A vulnerability was found in AllenAI AllenNLP up to 2
summary: A vulnerability was found in AllenAI AllenNLP up to 2.10.1. This impacts the function Registrable.resolve_class_name of the file allennlp/common/registrable.py of the component Registrable Configuration Machinery. Performing a manipulation of the argument Type results in code injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

title: CVE-2026-116280 — A vulnerability was determined in Kameleo up to 5
summary: A vulnerability was determined in Kameleo up to 5.0.1.26. Affected is the function InternalController.TestProxy of the file client-engine-application/f.cs of the component Proxy Validation. Executing a manipulation of the argument host/port can lead to server-side request forgery. The attack may be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 5.2.0 is able to address this issue. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. The route has been removed and replaced with /general/test-proxy in 5.2.0.

title: CVE-2026-116281 — A vulnerability was identified in Kameleo up to 5
summary: A vulnerability was identified in Kameleo up to 5.0.1.26. Affected by this vulnerability is the function ListProfiles of the file client-engine-application/t.cs of the component Profile Controller. The manipulation leads to information disclosure. The attack can only be performed from a local environment. Upgrading to version 5.2.0 addresses this issue. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.

title: CVE-2026-116282 — A security flaw has been discovered in Kameleo up to 5
summary: A security flaw has been discovered in Kameleo up to 5.3.1. Affected by this issue is the function CookieController.ListCookies of the file client-engine-application/w.cs of the component Cookie Controller. The manipulation of the argument guid results in information disclosure. The attack can be executed remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: CVE-2026-116283 — A weakness has been identified in Kameleo up to 5
summary: A weakness has been identified in Kameleo up to 5.0.1.26. This affects an unknown part of the file /profiles of the component Local API. This manipulation causes information disclosure. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. Upgrading to version 5.2.0 is able to mitigate this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

title: CVE-2026-116485 — danmu_api before 1
summary: danmu_api before 1.21.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify server environment configuration when the default TOKEN is used and ADMIN_TOKEN is unset. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/env/set, /api/env/add, or /api/env/del to set ADMIN_TOKEN, lock out operators, redirect OTHER_SERVER or PROXY_URL for SSRF, and trigger redeployment.

title: CVE-2026-116486 — Objenesis before 3
summary: Objenesis before 3.6 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows code in one class loader to substitute objects into another by exploiting instantiator caching keyed on class name. When a shared ObjenesisStd instance caches instantiators by clazz.getName() in ObjenesisBase.getInstantiatorOf(), same-named classes collide, causing newInstance() to return wrong-class objects and ClassCastException failures.

title: CVE-2026-116487 — NXP MCUXpresso SDK USB middleware (mcuxsdk-middleware-usb) before 2
summary: NXP MCUXpresso SDK USB middleware (mcuxsdk-middleware-usb) before 2.13.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in USB_DeviceCdcRndisSetCommand() that trusts a host-supplied informationBufferOffset. A malicious USB host can send RNDIS SET messages for OID_GEN_CURRENT_PACKET_FILTER or OID_802_3_MULTICAST_LIST with an out-of-range offset to read and disclose device memory.

title: CVE-2026-116488 — NXP MCUXpresso SDK USB middleware (mcuxsdk-middleware-usb) before 2
summary: NXP MCUXpresso SDK USB middleware (mcuxsdk-middleware-usb) before 2.13.0 contains a heap buffer overflow in host audio, video and CDC class drivers that trust device-supplied bNumEndpoints and bLength values. A malicious USB device can supply crafted descriptors that write endpoint entries past the fixed-size epList array, corrupting heap memory for code execution or denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-116492 — Frappe CRM app before 1
summary: Frappe CRM app before 1.89.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to read CRM Lead records they are not permitted to access by querying the get_contact_by_phone_number API, which performs raw database queries without invoking the permission system. Attackers can supply a known phone number to the crm.integrations.api.get_contact_by_phone_number endpoint to retrieve full lead details otherwise blocked by standard API and UI access controls, resulting in unauthorized disclosure of sensitive CRM data.

title: CVE-2026-116516 — Mattermost versions <=11
summary: Mattermost versions <=11.9 11.1.9 11.5.8 11.10.7.0 fail to validate Zoom chat line length before slicing which allows an authenticated attacker to crash the Agents plugin via summarizing a Zoom chat transcription containing short continuation lines. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00723

title: CVE-2026-59106 — A security vulnerability has been identified in the WolfProt interface implementation
summary: A security vulnerability has been identified in the WolfProt interface implementation. Insufficient neutralization of user-controlled input could allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to a vulnerable service to execute operating-system commands with the privileges of the affected application service.

title: CVE-2026-59107 — A security vulnerability has been identified in the vSolution Matrix file sharing feature
summary: A security vulnerability has been identified in the vSolution Matrix file sharing feature. A shared cryptographic trust configuration could allow an attacker who obtains the matching private key to authenticate to an affected device via SSH as root. This vulnerability affects only devices configured as a vSolution Matrix main/master station with the file sharing feature enabled.

title: CVE-2026-97200 — Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in hackney_conn in benoitc hackney allows a malicious HTTP server to exhaust client
summary:
Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in hackney_conn in benoitc hackney allows a malicious HTTP server to exhaust client memory via an oversized or highly compressed response body. hackney:request/5 and hackney:body/1 return the whole response body, and nothing bounds how much the connection process buffers. Any server the client requests can trigger it.

hackney_conn:read_full_body/2 and the HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 accumulators append every chunk until the body ends. With {auto_decompress, true} the buffered body is then inflated in one step with zlib:gunzip/1 or zlib:

title: CVE-2026-106781 — An issue in WCH CH340/CH341 USB-to-Serial Windows Driver setup package CH341SER
summary: An issue in WCH CH340/CH341 USB-to-Serial Windows Driver setup package CH341SER.EXE version 4.0 allows a local attacker to escalate privileges.

title: CVE-2026-110733 — Vulnerability in the SQL storage module of Apache SIS
summary:
Vulnerability in the SQL storage module of Apache SIS. When sorting a stream of features, the clause is copied after ORDER BY without quoting the identifier character. A crafter sort clause could inject SQL in the query.





This issue affects the sql-storage module of Apache SIS from version 1.0 through 1.6 inclusive. Other modules such as sis-referencing are not impacted. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.7, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-110748 — This issue affects Apache SIS from version 0
summary:
This issue affects Apache SIS from version 0.7 through 1.6 inclusive. When a data file contains links to other files, Apache SIS opened these files regardless their paths. It was possible, for example, to specify a path to a local file. However, these files were always expected to be in some specific formats and the reading stops at the first parsing error, which makes this vulnerability unlikely to leak sensitive information. The impacted formats are:

  *  Geographic Markup Language (GML) with `xlink:href` attributes for other files in GML format.
  *  Well Known Text (WKT) with parameter el

title: CVE-2026-112345 — TTLock Android application before v9
summary: TTLock Android application before v9.8.260718 and associated smart-lock firmware contain a hardcoded static AES key vulnerability that allows an attacker within Bluetooth range to decrypt the per-pairing session key transmitted during BLE pairing. Attackers can observe the pairing exchange, recover the persistent session key using the embedded defaultKey, and forge authenticated BLE requests to unlock the device, add fingerprints or access codes, and perform administrative actions without authentication or user interaction.

title: CVE-2026-115930 — The MongoDB Shell (mongosh) relies on Node
summary: The MongoDB Shell (mongosh) relies on Node.js as a third-party runtime that carries its own TLS root certificate store. This certificate store has the recoverable eMudhra intermediate CA certificates. This issue impacts MongoDB Shell (mongosh) versions prior to 2.14.0 and can be resolved by updating to mongosh 2.14.0 which bundles Node.js 24.22.1 or later. If mongosh is installed through npm, it uses the Node.js runtime installed on the host; update that runtime separately.

title: CVE-2026-116284 — A security vulnerability has been detected in Kameleo up to 5
summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Kameleo up to 5.3.1. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file /general/user-info of the component Local API. Such manipulation leads to information disclosure. The attack may be performed from remote. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: CVE-2026-116339 — A vulnerability was determined in iFlytek astron-agent up to 1
summary: A vulnerability was determined in iFlytek astron-agent up to 1.1.2. This affects an unknown function of the file core/memory/database/api/v1/exec_ddl.py of the component DDL Whitelist Handler. This manipulation causes incomplete blacklist. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: CVE-2026-116340 — A vulnerability was identified in iFlytek astron-agent up to 1
summary: A vulnerability was identified in iFlytek astron-agent up to 1.1.2. This impacts the function FileInfoV2Service.listKnowledgeByPage of the file FileInfoV2Service.java of the component Console Knowledge-List Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument space-id leads to authorization bypass. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: CVE-2026-116497 — A NULL pointer dereference vulnerability was found in gssproxy
summary: A NULL pointer dereference vulnerability was found in gssproxy. When a GSSX_INIT_SEC_CONTEXT request is received with the target_name field absent, the daemon dereferences the resulting NULL pointer and crashes. The request requires no authentication, allowing any local user to crash the gssproxy daemon via its Unix socket. The daemon does not automatically restart, resulting in a persistent denial of service that also affects dependent services such as Kerberized NFS and IdM.

title: CVE-2026-31158 — SQL Injection vulnerability in CRM SOFTTRADE Infotech (aka softtradeindia) 1
summary: SQL Injection vulnerability in CRM SOFTTRADE Infotech (aka softtradeindia) 1.0 allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the Login Page

title: CVE-2026-36698 — Xovis AG APS-R-POE, APS-R-POE-PP, APS-R, APS-R-POE-USB, and APS-B 2
summary: Xovis AG APS-R-POE, APS-R-POE-PP, APS-R, APS-R-POE-USB, and APS-B 2.10.1.1 and earlier contains an OS command injection vulnerability in /sbin/ImportParamSet.sh. The script processes symlinks from uploaded parameter archive files and embeds the symlink target path into a shell command without quoting or sanitization. The command is executed as root via APC_SendMsg IPC.

title: CVE-2026-3322 — Due to improper permission checks in Lobster_pro, attackers are able to interact with endpoints that should require administrative privileges
summary: Due to improper permission checks in Lobster_pro, attackers are able to interact with endpoints that should require administrative privileges. This issue affects Lobster_pro version 4.12.12-LTS and potentially other versions prior to 25.1.3.

title: CVE-2026-65184 — The root-privileged `wsserver` terminal-bridge daemon builds a shell command from client-supplied WebSocket fields and passes it to `system()` and `po
summary: The root-privileged `wsserver` terminal-bridge daemon builds a shell command from client-supplied WebSocket fields and passes it to `system()` and `popen()` without quoting, escaping, or character-set validation. The daemon's public-key session path performs no appliance-session check.

title: CVE-2026-77052 — boneIO Black exposes a Node-RED instance without authentication at the /nodered/ path through a Caddy reverse proxy
summary:
boneIO Black exposes a Node-RED instance without authentication at the /nodered/ path through a Caddy reverse proxy. The Node-RED Admin API allows deploying flows that can execute arbitrary system commands. An unauthenticated attacker on the local network can deploy a malicious flow to achieve remote code execution and gain full control over the home automation system.


This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-77053 — boneIO Black firmware ships with authentication disabled by default
summary:
boneIO Black firmware ships with authentication disabled by default. Its management web API listens on all network interfaces and exposes all endpoints without requiring credentials. An unauthenticated remote attacker can fully control the device, causing denial of service, modifying configuration, and operating connected physical circuits.
This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0: a device without an administrator account refuses API requests until the owner creates one in the first-run wizard, and every API route is restricted to an authenticated role.

Versions before 1.2.0 are based on Debian

title: CVE-2026-77054 — boneIO Black stores passwords, including the MQTT broker and web panel passwords, in cleartext
summary:
boneIO Black stores passwords, including the MQTT broker and web panel passwords, in cleartext. The GET /api/config endpoint returns the full configuration with sub-services passwords exposed. Any authenticated user can call the endpoint and access the administrative passwords in cleartext form. Critically, due to CVE-2026-77053 (authentication disabled by default), an unauthenticated attacker on the same local network can retrieve all passwords.

This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0: web panel passwords are stored as salted scrypt hashes in a file readable only by the service account, and th

title: CVE-2026-77055 — boneIO black_debian_images gives the boneio service account excessive privileges, including full passwordless sudo access and membership in the docker
summary:
boneIO black_debian_images gives the boneio service account excessive privileges, including full passwordless sudo access and membership in the docker group. A local attacker who compromises the boneio user can use these privileges to escalate to root.

This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0: the image removes the sudoers rule and the docker group membership when it is sealed, and devices already in the field have both removed by migrations shipped with boneio 1.6.0 and applied on first start after the upgrade. Privileged operations now go through helpers that accept only a fixed set of command

title: CVE-2026-77056 — boneIO black_debian_images ships with a Mosquitto MQTT broker that uses the same default credentials on all devices
summary:
boneIO black_debian_images ships with a Mosquitto MQTT broker that uses the same default credentials on all devices. These credentials are publicly documented on github, and there is no indication in the instructions to change them. A remote attacker can use them to gain full read and write access to the broker, allowing control of connected relays, blinds, and gates, and injection of fake entities into a linked Home Assistant installation.

This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0 of the image: MQTT passwords are generated per device at first boot. Devices upgraded from earlier versions keep the

title: CVE-2026-77057 — boneIO Black does not limit authentication attempts on its web interface (POST /api/login) or SSH service, and does not enforce password complexity
summary:
boneIO Black does not limit authentication attempts on its web interface (POST /api/login) or SSH service, and does not enforce password complexity. An unauthenticated remote attacker can make unlimited brute-force login attempts, potentially compromising user accounts and gaining unauthorized access to the device.

This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0: web login attempts are rate-limited per source address and per account, panel passwords must be at least 8 characters long, and SSH allows three authentication attempts per connection with a shortened login grace time.

title: CVE-2026-77058 — boneIO Black is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) on all state-changing API endpoints because it lacks CSRF tokens and does not validate
summary: boneIO Black is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) on all state-changing API endpoints because it lacks CSRF tokens and does not validate Origin or Referer headers. A remote attacker can craft a malicious webpage that, when visited by a user on the internal network, sends cross-origin requests to the device. This allows the attacker to reboot the controller, toggle relay circuits, control gates and blinds, or shut down the device, causing loss of integrity and availability. Critically, due to CVE-2026-77053 (authentication disabled by default), any user on the same internal networ

title: CVE-2026-77059 — boneIO Black contains a TOCTOU race condition in the create_timedatectl_sudoers_file() function in boneio/webui/routes/timezone_sudoers
summary:
boneIO Black contains a TOCTOU race condition in the create_timedatectl_sudoers_file() function in boneio/webui/routes/timezone_sudoers.py. The function writes sudoers rules to a predictable temporary file, validates them, then installs them with root privileges. A local attacker can exploit the race window between validation and installation to substitute malicious content, or use the predictable filename for symlink attacks, resulting in arbitrary sudoers rule injection and local privilege escalation to root.

This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-77060 — boneIO black_debian_images stores the Mosquitto MQTT broker password file at /etc/mosquitto/passwd with world-readable permissions
summary:
boneIO black_debian_images stores the Mosquitto MQTT broker password file at /etc/mosquitto/passwd with world-readable permissions. Any local user can read the password hashes for all MQTT accounts and perform offline dictionary attacks.

This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-77061 — boneIO Black directly excludes several API endpoints from the authentication
summary:
boneIO Black directly excludes several API endpoints from the authentication. An unauthenticated remote attacker on the local network can retrieve system logs, firmware version, serial number, MQTT username, configuration file listings, and API documentation. This data aids reconnaissance and enables targeted attacks against the device.
This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0: every API route requires an authenticated role, the interactive API documentation is disabled, and the serial number is withheld from anonymous callers.

title: CVE-2026-77062 — The boneIO Black web interface lacks proper clickjacking protections
summary:
The boneIO Black web interface lacks proper clickjacking protections. A remote attacker can embed the control panel in an iframe on a malicious web page and trick an authenticated user on the internal network into clicking buttons that activate relays, open gates, or control blinds. This can lead to unauthorized state changes with potential physical safety consequences. Critically, due to CVE-2026-77053 (authentication disabled by default), any user on the same internal network can trigger attacker-controlled actions by visiting the malicious website.

This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-90885 — Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference vulnerability in Apache Camel Saxon component
summary:
Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference vulnerability in Apache Camel Saxon component.



This issue affects Apache Camel: from 4.0.0 before 4.18.5, from 4.19.0 before 4.22.2.



XQueryBuilder in camel-saxon, which evaluates expressions for the xquery language and the xquery component, built its default Saxon Configuration with parse options that set only a whitespace stripping rule, leaving the XML parser at its defaults, under which a DOCTYPE declaration is accepted and external entities are resolved. A message body of type String or byte[], or any body read as an InputStream,

title: CVE-2026-92171 — A flaw was found in the Infinispan Operator for Red Hat Data Grid
summary: A flaw was found in the Infinispan Operator for Red Hat Data Grid. When cross-site (xsite) TLS is enabled, the operator launches the Gossip Router container with keystore and truststore passwords passed as plain-text command-line arguments (`-tls_keystore_password`, `-tls_truststore_password`). Container args are stored in the Pod spec and visible to any principal with `get pods` permission in the namespace (no `get secrets` required), to node-level processes via `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, and frequently captured in audit/event logs.

title: CVE-2026-93328 — Path Traversal and Missing Authorization in cloud-storage source in Google Cloud MCP Toolbox for Databases (googleapis/mcp-toolbox) versions 1
summary: Path Traversal and Missing Authorization in cloud-storage source in Google Cloud MCP Toolbox for Databases (googleapis/mcp-toolbox) versions 1.2.0 through 1.4.0 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to exfiltrate host files to external Google Cloud Storage buckets and overwrite arbitrary local files via crafted tool invocation parameters.

title: CVE-2026-93847 — Mattermost versions 11
summary: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.10 fail to validate reserved system post types on the scheduled post creation and publication paths which allows an authenticated channel member to publish messages rendering as trusted system events via the scheduled post endpoint.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00732

title: CVE-2026-93848 — Mattermost versions 11
summary: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.10 fail to apply outbound internal-connection filtering to the OpenID discovery endpoint request which allows a System Administrator to determine whether internal addresses and ports are reachable from the server via an unauthenticated login request that triggers the discovery fetch.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00774

title: CVE-2026-93849 — Mattermost versions 11
summary: Mattermost versions 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5, 11.7.x <= 11.7.10, 11.10.x <= 11.10.1 Mattermost fail to apply allocation limits to the byte-string decode paths in its WebSocket msgpack decoder, which allows an authenticated remote attacker to cause excessive server memory allocation via a crafted binary WebSocket frame declaring a Bin32 payload length of up to 4,294,967,295 bytes.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00768

title: CVE-2026-93850 — Mattermost versions 11
summary: Mattermost versions 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5, 11.7.x <= 11.7.10, 11.10.x <= 11.10.1 fail to bind the volume of text extracted from an uploaded PDF which allows an authenticated user to exhaust server memory and cause a denial of service via a crafted PDF whose compressed content stream expands into a very large amount of text.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00769

title: CVE-2026-94386 — Use of Cache Containing Sensitive Information vulnerability in Apache Camel Oauth component
summary:
Use of Cache Containing Sensitive Information vulnerability in Apache Camel Oauth component.



This issue affects Apache Camel: from 4.19.0 before 4.22.2.



OAuthClientCredentialsTokenResolver obtains OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens through the client credentials grant on behalf of the components that authenticate their outbound calls with a named OAuth profile, such as camel-openai, camel-langchain4j-agent, camel-huggingface, camel-docling, camel-a2a, camel-spring-ai-chat and the IBM watsonx components, and of applications that call the OAuthClientAuthenticationFactory SPI directly. title: CVE-2026-107080 — OpenJPEG 2

summary: Syncplify Server! before 8.8.0 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated SFTP users to evade per-path permission overrides by exploiting case-insensitive filesystem path resolution and 8.3 short names. Attackers can address a protected directory using alternate capitalization or its 8.3 short name to perform file uploads and downloads that the configured override is intended to deny, resulting in unauthorized file access.
